wants.text: Understand which decision mechanisms actually operate in the current engine.
Maintain an evidence-backed account of the decision mechanisms for collaborators.
Keep the account concise enough to inspect quickly.

notes.text: Ledger selection diffuses scope-seeded mass through preference parent and catalyst links; its horizon and attention limit are explicit settings.
A candidate becomes a commitment only after the controller records a forecast and selects it within existing authority.
Observed returns record forecast residual separately from named unmet desires; generated preference refinements remain pending admission.
